StructuredXMLResume.ExecutiveSummary:
Jagannath has over 13 years of extensive experience in managing large and complex programs and projects, involving multiple geographies, spanning different types of engagements from large application development, application maintenance, and business process re-engineering and distributed systems. He has worked with Fortune 500 Clients in Banking & Financial Service, HealthCare and Logistics Industries in United States and Canada. He is a PMI certified project manager (PMP), skilled in process improvement, streamlining, optimizing, oversight and control, having experience in handling end to end BPM programs of various scales and complexities, predominantly in PEGA based engagements. He has extensive experience managing all phases of system development including requirements definition, design, construction, testing, implementation and support. He has experience in Enterprise Architecture (TOGAF), Distributed Systems (SOA) and Big Data Platform. Jagannath is a Certified Scrum Master (CSM), having experience in various SDLC methodologies like Agile, Iterative and Waterfall. He is excellent in client relationship management, with strong leadership and interpersonal skills. Prior to joining Cognizant, Jagannath worked as a solution architect for Wipro Technologies.
Jagannath Sarkar, PMP®, CSM

PositionHistory.Title: Management
PositionHistory.Description: Jagannath Sarkar, PMP®, CSM Project Title GMS Exposure Management Duration Sep 2012 - April 2013 Location Phoenix, AZ, USA Operating Systems IBM AIX v6.1, Windows Programming Languages Pega Rules Process Commander PRPCv5.5, DB2, Java, Hadoop, Teradata PROJECT DESCRIPTION: GMS Exposure Management provides an end to end case management and risk monitoring capability for monitoring the financial stability and exposure of merchants, who have a proprietary contract with the bank. Merchant exposure arises out of non-delivery of goods and services to card members and disputes/returns for which the bank has already made a payment to the merchant. This exposure can be partly or fully mitigated through collaterals which would include pending payments to merchants, holdbacks, and other forms of collateral example lien, letters of credit. Merchant exposure and collateral information was dispersed across various platforms, so it was difficult to estimate and mitigate merchant exposure efficiently. This project aims at improving accuracy and simplifying the existing capabilities for monitoring merchant risk exposure, decision and risk assessment document collection while reducing the overhead costs by removing redundant systems/capabilities. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Jagannath is the Project Manager for this Global Exposure Management Managed distributed project teams Responsible for project planning, estimation, delivery and change management Managed client relationships Prepared SOA, project charter, project management plan, risk and contingency plan Provided technical leadership to BPM project team on resolving /addressing critical issues, identifying process improvement areas
